metadata.name: inside_job
metadata.description: INSIDE JOB - real-time sealed social deduction on MagicBlock Private Ephemeral Rollups

instructions.name: act
docs: The one gameplay instruction. Move / hold USE / cuff / report / emergency all look
identical on the wire, so not even transaction metadata says what you did.

instructions.name: buy_ticket
docs: Staked tables: pay `stake` (USDC) into this heist's Pot on Solana and name the
session key that may use the ticket to take a seat in the rollup. The Pot is plain
base-layer state (never delegated), so the money never leaves Solana.

instructions.name: buy_tip
docs: Spectators: stake `amount` (USDC) on this heist's Tip Line and name the session key
that will make your pick inside the rollup. One entry per wallet per heist.

instructions.name: chat
docs: Public chat: in the lobby, during meetings (living players only) and after the game.
Nobody talks during the heist.

instructions.name: claim_tip
docs: Pay one Tip Line entry what it's owed, into its wallet's token account. Permissionless.

instructions.name: commit_deal
docs: Push the Room (now carrying `deal_commit`) to Solana before the heist gets going, so
the deal is on the base layer while it's still sealed. Anyone may call it, once per
heist. At lights-on anyone checks the revealed seed against this commitment.

instructions.name: create_room
docs: Create a room and pre-fund it: its lamports follow it into the rollup and pay
for the sealed accounts and their permissions there.
`mint` is the SPL token stakes and tips are paid in (devnet USDC); `stake` is in its
base units per seat (0 = free table; free tables still run a Tip Line in `mint`).

instructions.name: deal
docs: VRF callback. Roles = H(vrf ‖ every seat's sealed salt ‖ room ‖ match): the oracle
can't know the Mole (it never sees the salts) and no player can steer it.

accounts.name: vrf_program_identity
docs: Scoped VRF identity PDA, bound to this program. Its presence as a signer proves
the callback was issued by the VRF program for this program.

instructions.name: delegate_room
docs: Hand the room to the TEE validator.

instructions.name: fallback_deal
docs: If the oracle is silent for ~6 s, any seated player can deal from rollup state.
Still mixed with the sealed salts; flagged in the UI as not VRF-grade.

instructions.name: finish
docs: Lights on: World, every View and the move log flip to public, so anyone can check
the deal (VRF + salts) and replay the whole heist. remaining: [view_i, view_perm_i] x 8
(+ the Pot on staked tables). Every heist's final Room — winner, roles, deal
commitment, log hash — is committed to Solana, with Magic Actions that resolve the
Tip Line and pay the Pot there, in the same flow as the reveal.

instructions.name: join
docs: Take a seat. `signer` is the in-browser session key; `wallet` is who you play for.
Your sealed salt goes straight into the World, where nobody can read it.
Staked tables: `pot_nonce` names the base-layer Pot, passed as remaining account 0.
The rollup reads the ticket from Solana and only seats the session key it names.

instructions.name: leave
docs: Leave a seat (lobby or after the game). The seat's View is sealed again.

instructions.name: pick
docs: Tip Line: call who the Mole is (spectators only). Signed by the session key the
tip named; remaining account 0 is the base-layer Market, read inside the rollup.
Weight = heist time left, so an early call is worth more. Re-picking is allowed but
resets the weight to now. Closed once the heist ends; dead seats can't be picked.

instructions.name: record_tips
docs: Resolve a heist's Tip Line from the committed Room: copies every pick, the roles and
the winner, and computes each entry's payout. Runs as a Magic Action right after the
lights-on commit; permissionless while the committed Room is still this heist.
Never resolvable (heist abandoned, commit lost)? 20 minutes after the first tip the
same call turns the Tip Line into full refunds instead.
remaining accounts (any order): the Market, the Room.

instructions.name: refund
docs: Never settled (crank died, nobody started, commit lost)? After 20 minutes anyone can
return every ticket. Refund, never re-roll.

instructions.name: reset
docs: Back to the lobby: re-seal the World and give each View back to its seat only.

instructions.name: set_salt
docs: Lobby heartbeat + a fresh sealed salt for the next deal (salts are revealed at lights-on).

instructions.name: settle
docs: Pay out a finished staked heist. Runs on Solana as the Magic Action that the TEE
schedules at lights-on, right after it commits the Room. It is also permissionless:
the outcome is read from the committed Room, so a direct call pays exactly the same.
No oracle and no admin: the result was sealed program state all along.
remaining accounts (any order): the Pot, the Room, the Pot's token account, the mint,
the token program, every ticket holder's token account.

instructions.name: setup_core
docs: Create the sealed World (zero readers), the sealed move log, and make the Room
publicly readable. Call again until it's a no-op: each later call grows the move
log by up to 10 KiB (one CPI realloc) toward its full size.

instructions.name: setup_view
docs: Create one seat's private View (no readers until someone sits down).

instructions.name: start_match
docs: Host starts: bots fill empty seats, VRF is requested, the 100 ms crank is scheduled.
remaining accounts: view0..view7 (writable).

instructions.name: tick
docs: One 100 ms step. Called by the crank; any client may call it too as a liveness
fallback — the slot gate stops double-ticking.

instructions.name: vote
docs: Sealed ballot: stored in the World, published for everyone at once at the tally.

errors.name: NotHost
errors.msg: only the host can do that

errors.name: NoTicket
errors.msg: staked table: buy a ticket on Solana first (or the rollup hasn't seen it yet; retry)

errors.name: PotMismatch
errors.msg: this table is playing for a different pot

errors.name: PotClosed
errors.msg: the pot is already settled or refunded

errors.name: DuplicateTicket
errors.msg: you already hold a ticket for this pot

errors.name: NotSettleable
errors.msg: the committed room does not match this pot (not finished yet?)

errors.name: BadMint
errors.msg: wrong token mint, or not an SPL token account

errors.name: TipRange
errors.msg: tip must be between 0.1 and 5 USDC

errors.name: MarketFull
errors.msg: the Tip Line for this heist is full

errors.name: MarketClosed
errors.msg: the Tip Line for this heist is closed

errors.name: DuplicateTip
errors.msg: this wallet already tipped this heist

errors.name: NoTip
errors.msg: no tip for this session key (or the rollup hasn't seen it yet; retry)

errors.name: Insider
errors.msg: players in this crew can't tip on it

errors.name: BadPick
errors.msg: pick a living seat in this heist

errors.name: NotResolved
errors.msg: the Tip Line hasn't been resolved yet

types.name: Market
docs: The Tip Line for one heist: spectators stake on which seat is the Mole. Base-layer
escrow (tokens in the Market's ATA). Picks are made inside the rollup and land in the
Room; at lights-on a Magic Action copies the committed result here. No oracle.

fields.name: winner
docs: winning team, copied from the committed Room (255 = unresolved)

fields.name: sessions
docs: the session key that may pick for each entry inside the rollup

fields.name: claimed
docs: bit e set once entry e has been paid

types.name: Pot
docs: Base-layer escrow for one staked heist. Never delegated: it lives on Solana and is
paid out by `settle`, which reads the Room state the TEE committed at lights-on.
The stakes themselves sit in the Pot's token account (an ATA of the Pot PDA).

fields.name: winner
docs: winning team copied from the committed Room at settle (255 = refunded)

fields.name: wallets
docs: who paid

fields.name: sessions
docs: the session key each ticket authorises to take a seat in the rollup

fields.name: paid
docs: what each ticket received at settle / refund

fields.name: phase_end
docs: unix seconds: end of the current meeting / result screen

fields.name: players
docs: the in-browser session key of each seat (signs every gameplay tx)

fields.name: wallets
docs: the wallet each seat plays for (payouts in staked mode)

fields.name: last_seen
docs: unix seconds each seat last acted (lobby presence)

fields.name: seed_state
docs: 0 = not dealt, 1 = VRF, 2 = fallback (not VRF-grade, flagged in the UI)

fields.name: alive_pub
docs: public life status: only updated when a meeting reveals the dead

fields.name: last_votes
docs: votes of the last meeting, published all at once at the tally

fields.name: roles_pub
docs: roles, published only when the game ends

fields.name: pot_nonce
docs: the base-layer Pot this heist is played for (0 = no pot yet / free table)

fields.name: stake
docs: token base units (USDC: 6 decimals) per seat; 0 = free table

fields.name: mint
docs: the SPL mint stakes and tips are paid in (devnet USDC)

fields.name: deal_commit
docs: H("inside-job/commit/v1" ‖ seed ‖ room ‖ heist): pushed to Solana before play

fields.name: log_hash
docs: running SHA-256 over the move log: committed to Solana with the result

fields.name: deal_committed
docs: 1 once the Room carrying `deal_commit` has been committed to Solana

fields.name: tip_n
docs: Tip Line entries that have picked this heist (index into the base-layer Market)

fields.name: tip_seat
docs: each Tip Line entry's suspect (NO_PICK = none yet)

fields.name: tip_weight
docs: each entry's weight: heist time left when it last picked (earlier = more)
